one_line: Legendary South Indian rasashastra alchemist working with mercury, metals and mineral medicines.

appearance.age_look: Mid-40s, lean and wiry, with the calm focus of a seasoned scholar-artisan.
appearance.face: Oval face, medium-brown Deccan complexion, sharp nose, neatly trimmed beard and moustache, slightly furrowed brows, thoughtful almond-shaped eyes with a steady, analytical gaze; default expression is composed curiosity, as if observing a reaction in progress.
appearance.hair: Straight, black hair pulled back into a short, low knot at the nape; front kept tidy with a middle part; simple, narrow, dark-brown cloth headband tied around the forehead to keep hair back, with no ornament.
appearance.costume: He wears a late first-millennium South Indian scholar-artisan outfit: a knee-length, long-sleeved cotton tunic (angarkha-style wrap) in muted indigo blue, cross-tied at the right side with beige cords; a cream-colored cotton dhoti wrapped securely from waist to ankles in the Deccan style, with a thin rust-red border; over one shoulder and occasionally around his neck lies a lightweight, off-white cotton uttariya (shawl) with sparse fine brown stripes, slightly smoke-stained at the edges from the furnace; simple leather sandals on his feet; minimal jewellery limited to a thin copper bangle on his right wrist and a small rudraksha bead necklace, reflecting a learned but practical life; the fabrics look plain and functional, with subtle handwoven texture and no royal finery, suitable for a laboratory environment.
appearance.signature: A shallow, round bronze crucible held carefully in one hand, its outer surface darkened from repeated heating, with a faint metallic glow inside suggesting heated mercury or powdered metal—his constant prop symbolizing rasashastra experimentation with dangerous, powerful substances.

ref_desc: Nagarjuna the Alchemist is a lean, bearded mid-40s South Indian scholar with tied-back black hair and headband, wearing an indigo tunic, cream dhoti, off-white shawl, copper bangle and rudraksha necklace, always holding a darkened bronze crucible, in an indigo, cream, rust-red, off-white and dark-brown palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Nagarjuna the Alchemist: a lean, mid-40s South Indian rasashastra scholar with an oval, medium-brown face, short black hair tied in a low knot and controlled by a simple dark-brown cloth headband, a neat beard and moustache, and thoughtful almond eyes with a composed, curious expression. He wears a knee-length, long-sleeved indigo-blue wrap tunic tied at the right with beige cords, a cream-colored dhoti wrapped from waist to ankles with a thin rust-red border, and an off-white cotton shawl with fine brown stripes draped over one shoulder, all in plain, practical handwoven textures; add a thin copper bangle on his right wrist, a small rudraksha bead necklace at his collarbone, and simple leather sandals. In one hand he carefully holds his signature shallow round bronze crucible, its outside darkened from the furnace and its interior faintly glowing, symbolizing his work with mercury and metals. Show him head-to-toe in consistent colors—indigo, cream, rust red, off-white, dark brown—ready to be redrawn from multiple angles, with subtle hints of a lab environment (like distant furnace light or smoke staining on the shawl) but keep the focus on his face, hair, garments, and crucible.
